name: Can You Forgive Me?
source:
Can You Forgive Me? is a short point and click visual novel where you play as "Panda" right after your best friend "Fox's" suicide and funeral. You have 1 week to "get better" before you need to go back to work.

[From [url=https://dennen14.itch.io/can-you-forgive-me]itch.io[/url]]
